Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data. Note of 2026-07-27: this observation carried the source 'Exemple de demonstration, a remplacer' with confidence 'sourced', a demonstration placeholder left over from the seeding. A placeholder is not a source, and leaving it in inflated the count of sourced values by two across the repository. Source removed, confidence returned to estimated. The value itself is untouched: it was never sourced to begin with.

Web check of 2026-07-27, resuming the point left open by the previous pass, now settled. One establishment retained: ESNAM Margareta Niculescu, Charleville-Mezieres, within the International Institute of Puppetry. Criteria read at source: a three-year course awarding the DNSPC with the puppeteer-actor specialism, registered at RNCP level 6, the school being accredited by the Ministry of Culture. The previous pass left the upper bound at 2, unable to settle what became of the DMA in puppetry arts after the 2019 reform of that qualification. That candidate is now eliminated: the directory entry still titled DMA in puppetry arts in fact describes ESNAM's own course, a national qualification at RNCP level 6, three years, entry by competition. The DMA title is a stale directory identifier, not a second course. The upper bound therefore comes back to 1. The Institute's page further states that ESNAM is the only school in France given over entirely to initial puppetry training since 1987, a claim this time read at source rather than glimpsed in a search summary. The URCA master's in Circus and Puppetry and the bachelor's in Arts with a puppetry pathway remain excluded as before: the first is not specialised, the second is tied to the ESNAM entrance examination and is not a distinct school. The network blocking that prevented any source being read in the previous pass no longer applies. Status moved from disputed to verified.

establishments.description: Created in 1987 inside the International Institute of Puppetry, accredited by the Ministry of Culture, and the only school in France given over entirely to initial puppetry training. Entry is by competitive examination held every three years.

observations.reasoning: DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
